# Haseeb Qureshi

> Haseeb Qureshi is Managing Partner at Dragonfly, a crypto venture fund, and co-host of The Chopping Block podcast. He was previously a software engineer at Airbnb and Earn.com (acquired by Coinbase), and before that a professional poker player and author of How to Be a Poker Player: The Philosophy of Poker.

Canonical bio: https://haseebq.com/about/
X: https://x.com/hosseeb
Podcast: https://haseebq.com/podcast/ (The Chopping Block, with Unchained: https://unchainedcrypto.com/the-chopping-block/)
Firm: https://www.dragonfly.xyz/

## Selected essays

- [How to Build a VC Firm](https://haseebq.com/how-to-build-a-vc-firm/): how Dragonfly was built, through the launch of its $650M Fund IV in 2026
- [In Defense of Exponentials](https://haseebq.com/in-defense-of-exponentials/): on AI progress and why exponential forecasts keep beating linear ones
- [What Explains the Rise of AMMs?](https://haseebq.com/what-explains-the-rise-of-amms/): how automated market makers came to dominate crypto trading
- [The Reign of Terra: The Rise and Fall of UST](https://haseebq.com/the-reign-of-terra-the-rise-and-fall-of-ust/): postmortem of the Terra collapse
- [Flash Loans: Why Flash Attacks Will Be the New Normal](https://haseebq.com/flash-loans-why-flash-attacks-will-be-the-new-normal/)
- [The Life and Death of Plasma](https://haseebq.com/the-life-and-death-of-plasma/): why Ethereum's first scaling roadmap failed
- [Stablecoins: Designing a Price-Stable Cryptocurrency](https://haseebq.com/stablecoins-designing-a-price-stable-cryptocurrency/)
- [A Hacker Stole $31M of Ether — How It Happened](https://haseebq.com/a-hacker-stole-31m-of-ether/)
- [Why Decentralization Isn't as Important as You Think](https://haseebq.com/why-decentralization-isnt-as-important-as-you-think/)
- [How Not to Bomb Your Offer Negotiation](https://haseebq.com/how-not-to-bomb-your-offer-negotiation/): the widely shared salary negotiation guide
